panels.title: SLOs y Error Budget (ventana móvil de 30 días)

options.content:
**SLI 1 · Login:** `$slo_login %` de las peticiones a `/api/v1/auth` sin 5xx (los 4xx no cuentan).

**SLI 2 · API de consultas:** `$slo_api %` de los `GET` a `/userstories`, `/tasks`, `/issues` y `/epics` con `assigned_to`/`assigned_users` sin 5xx ni 429 (los demás 4xx no cuentan).

**SLI 3 · Latencia:** `$slo_latency_target %` de las peticiones exitosas a `/api/v1/` en `<= $slo_latency_ms ms`.

**Error budget** = 1 − SLO. *Restante* = 1 − (eventos malos / eventos permitidos).

**Burn rate** = tasa de eventos malos / (1 − SLO). Alertas multiventana: 14.4× en 1 h y 5 min, 6× en 6 h y 30 min.

Fuente: Application Insights `appi-taiga` (OpenTelemetry de taiga-back).

panels.title: SLI 1 · Login (30d)
panels.description: SLI de los últimos 30 días. Verde si cumple el SLO ($slo_login %).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp) and cloud_RoleName == "taiga-back"
| extend path = tostring(parse_url(url).Path), code = toint(resultCode)
| where path startswith "/api/v1/auth" and not(code between (400 .. 499))
| summarize total = sum(itemCount), bad = sumif(itemCount, code >= 500)
| where total > 0
| project sli = 100.0 * (1.0 - todouble(bad) / total)

panels.title: Error budget restante · Login
panels.description: Normal > 50 %, Alerta <= 50 %, Freeze <= 0 % (política de error budget).

panels.title: Estado del sistema (política de error budget)
panels.description: Lo decide el presupuesto más degradado de los tres. Freeze bloquea los despliegues (workflow error-budget).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp) and cloud_RoleName == "taiga-back"
| extend path = tostring(parse_url(url).Path), code = toint(resultCode)
| extend v1 = path startswith "/api/v1/auth" and not(code between (400 .. 499))
| extend v2 = name startswith "GET" and path matches regex @"^/api/v1/(userstories|tasks|issues|epics)/?$" and url has_any ("assigned_to", "assigned_users") and (not(code between (400 .. 499)) or code == 429)
| extend v3 = path startswith "/api/v1/" and code < 400
| summarize t1 = sumif(itemCount, v1), b1 = sumif(itemCount, v1 and code >= 500),
            t2 = sumif(itemCount, v2), b2 = sumif(itemCount, v2 and (code >= 500 or code == 429)),
            t3 = sumif(itemCount, v3), b3 = sumif(itemCount, v3 and duration > $slo_latency_ms)
| where t1 + t2 + t3 > 0
| project budget_min = min_of(
    iff(t1 == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * (1.0 - (todouble(b1) / t1) / (1.0 - $slo_login / 100.0))),
    iff(t2 == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * (1.0 - (todouble(b2) / t2) / (1.0 - $slo_api / 100.0))),
    iff(t3 == 0, 100.0, 100.0 * (1.0 - (todouble(b3) / t3) / (1.0 - $slo_latency_target / 100.0))))

panels.title: Gateway: peticiones por servicio y estado
panels.description: Access log JSON del nginx de entrada: cubre también front, events y taiga-protected.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ContainerName_s == "taiga-gateway" and Log_s startswith "{"
| extend r = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend uri = tostring(r.uri), status = toint(r.status), request_time = todouble(r.request_time)
| extend servicio = case(uri startswith "/api/" or uri startswith "/admin/", "taiga-back",
                         uri startswith "/events", "taiga-events",
                         uri startswith "/media/", "taiga-protected",
                         uri startswith "/static/", "estáticos (gateway)",
                         "taiga-front")
| extend clase = strcat(tostring(status / 100), "xx")
| summarize peticiones = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), serie = strcat(servicio, " ", clase)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

                         uri startswith "/events", "taiga-events",
                         uri startswith "/media/", "taiga-protected",
                         uri startswith "/static/", "estáticos (gateway)",
                         "taiga-front")
| where servicio != "taiga-events"
| summarize p95 = percentile(request_time, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), servicio
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: taiga-events y RabbitMQ: errores y conexiones
panels.description: Logs JSON de taiga-events (winston) y RabbitMQ: errores, warnings y cierres de conexión AMQP con su motivo.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ContainerName_s in ("taiga-events", "rabbitmq") and Log_s startswith "{"
| extend r = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend nivel = tostring(r.level), mensaje = coalesce(tostring(r.msg), tostring(r.message))
| where nivel in ("error", "warning", "warn", "critical") or mensaje has "closing AMQP connection"
| top 100 by TimeGenerated desc
| project TimeGenerated, contenedor = ContainerName_s, nivel, mensaje
